summary: Quashing criminal proceedings; FIR under sections 406, 420, 506, 120B IPC; charge-sheet lacks specific role for petitioner except as co-conspirator; section 180 IPC charge based on unsigned confessional statement; High Court declined quashing under section 482 Cr.PC; no material showing illegitimate prosecution or absence of offense; charges upheld as prima facie case exists; trial allowed to proceed.
legal_provisions_cited: Amit Kapoor vs. Ramesh Chandra (2012) 9 SCC 460
final_judgment: Appeal dismissed; High Court's refusal to quash is upheld; criminal proceedings to continue.
